*/defaults/main.yml.reason: Renovate automerges the role dependency pins (.github/renovate.json); the `# renovate:` comment stays unmasked so a datasource change still counts. Covers every role: one that gains a pin is masked without a new entry.
The unquoted `version:` of a Renovate-managed list entry such as dev_tools_pinned_tools, automerged like the quoted pins; the comment stays unmasked, and an entry without one (zizmor) stays watched.

Per-architecture SHA-256 checksums in a `checksum:` field or behind a `sha256:` prefix, which Renovate's post-upgrade task recomputes in every automerged pin bump (scripts/refresh-pin-checksums.py); other 64-hex values stay watched.
